entry.name: jit.gl.textureset
entry.digest: A set of textures for storage and resequencing
entry.description: The jit.gl.textureset object keeps a set of internal textures which may be written to or read from. This may be useful for data storage and/or texture resequencing. jit.gl.textureset mimics the functionality of jit.matrixset but outputs textures instead of matrices.

arguments.name: texturecount
arguments.digest: The number of textures in the texture set (default = 1)

arguments.name: drawto
arguments.digest: The named drawing context in which to draw (default = none). A named drawing context is a named instance of a,orobject. If no argument is provided the object will find a context implicitly.

attributes.name: adapt
attributes.digest: Enable adapt to input (default = 1)
attributes.description: Enableadapt to input attribute (default = 1). When enabled the texture output dimensions will match the input dimensions.
